# CalClaim

> CalClaim helps Californians find and claim public benefits via Telegram. Public pages may be crawled, indexed, and cited by search engines and AI systems.

## Public pages
- [Impact](https://calclaim.jayhasty.com/impact): funder impact dashboard and partner leaderboard
- [Partner signup](https://calclaim.jayhasty.com/partners/signup): community partner signup
